set.body:
Scope: Old image/transform/atlas/surface/MVPA modules, locus-data and mixed-spatial remnants, mvpa-foundation-spike, compatibility aliases and affected integration modules.

Deliverable: Complete the deletion ledger; retire facades and admission scaffolding after preserving meaningful tests. Combine modules only when optional dependencies and release responsibilities coincide.

Acceptance:
- All four extractions are complete; every replaced API maps to one live owner and its old implementation is gone.
- Architecture checks reject forbidden provider back-edges and duplicated axis/image/domain/frame/mesh/atlas-membership/provenance authorities; external compilation checks cover public boundaries.
- No forced fit/storage/graphics/platform dependency is introduced merely to reduce module count.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
